blockingFindings.title: R1 does not test that flow.hooks must be an object
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 test validates string-valued properties inside flow.hooks, but it never verifies that flow.hooks itself rejects a non-object value such as a string or array.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local config validation assertion that loadConfig rejects non-object flow.hooks values.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 explicitly requires flow.hooks to be an object, and that acceptance requirement has no corresponding negative validation coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Timeout coverage can pass without onHook using the timeout
blockingFindings.issue: The timeout requirement is tested only by calling buildHookCommandRunOptions, an implementation helper, rather than through onHook execution behavior or a production boundary used by onHook.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Replace or supplement the helper-only assertion with a test that proves onHook passes a 600000 ms timeout to its command execution path, without relying on an exported helper that onHook may not use.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R2 requires onHook to execute hooks with a 600000 ms timeout; the current test has a static anti-pattern because it can pass while production onHook omits the timeout.
